prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t reliably name a single “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, whether the case will need experts or a trial, and your priorities (speed of settlement, maximum recovery, communication style, etc.). I can, however, tell you how to find the strongest personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident and offer to help shortlist and contact several for you.

What to look for in a truck-accident lawyer
- Substantial truck-specific experience: look for attorneys who handle commercial vehicle/trucking cases regularly (not just general auto collisions). Trucking cases involve federal regulations, black-box/data recorders, logbooks, maintenance records and corporate defenses.
- Trial experience and verdicts: many insurance companies only take cases seriously if a lawyer will and can go to trial. Ask about jury verdicts in truck cases.
- Use of experts: accident reconstruction, trucking operations, biomechanical/medical experts, FMCSA/CSA consultants.
- Results with similar cases: settlements/verdicts for cases with similar injury severity and liability issues.
- Credentials and reputational indicators: board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (if applicable), AV Preeminent rating (Martindale-Hubbell), membership in groups such as Million Dollar Advocates Forum, Super Lawyers listings, peer reviews.
- Local courthouse experience: familiarity with Dallas judges, local defense counsel and juries is helpful.
- Communication and staffing: who will handle daily work, frequency of updates, accessibility.
- Fee structure: contingency fee %, who pays expert and court costs up front, what happens if you don’t recover.

Where to search and check credentials
- Texas State Bar (lawyer search / disciplinary history)
- Local Dallas bar association referral service
- Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo (reviews and peer ratings)
- Google/ Yelp client reviews and firm case results pages

Questions to ask at a free consult
1. How many truck-accident cases have you handled? How many in Dallas County?  
2. How many of those went to trial? Can you share past settlements/verdicts for similar cases?  
3. Who will handle my file day-to-day (name of the attorney and paralegals)?  
4. Do you work on contingency? What is your fee percentage and how are expenses handled?  
5. Which experts will you use? Have you worked with them before?  
6. How do you investigate liability (black box data, logs, maintenance records)?  
7. What is a realistic estimate for value and timeline?  
8. Can you provide client references or recent case studies?  
9. Are there any conflicts of interest?  
10. If we disagree about settlement, will you take the case to trial?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific recovery amount or fast settlement.  
- Refusal to provide references or examples of past truck cases.  
- No trial experience or unwillingness to try the case if necessary.  
- Pushy sales tactics or pressure to sign immediately.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a curated short list of Dallas truck-accident attorneys/firms known for this work (I’ll need your zip code or preferred region in Dallas and any other preferences).  
- Draft a short phone/email script you can use to contact attorneys.  
- Help evaluate responses from lawyers you’ve already contacted.

Do you want me to prepare a shortlist of Dallas attorneys now? If so, tell me your ZIP code and any preferences (budget concerns, language needs, willingness to go to trial, severity of injuries).
